intro.title: Trust our language experts for specialised translation
paras: Native speakers who master the source language are the starting point at BeTranslated. Specialised texts need more: translators who are also experts in a sector, from business and finance to technical fields.
Working alone or in multidisciplinary teams, they bring real industry know-how to every document.
checks: A native speaker of the target language
Credentials in at least one other sector
A network of qualified, accredited specialists
One translator or a team, depending on your timeline
